newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers 300 MW peak firm power Mon, prices rise.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers 300 MW peak firm power Mon, prices rise.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) continued to offer 300 megawatts of peak firm power for Monday delivery, but raised prices by $2.00 to $3.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Friday.
BPA offered peak firm power during heavy load hours on Monday at $31.00 per MWh for Northwest sales from $28.00 for Friday, and at $32.00 for California-Oregon border sales from $29.00 for Friday.

BPA also offered unlimited peak firm power during heavy load hours on Sunday at $23.00 in the Northwest and $24.00 at the California Oregon Border from 400 MW of peak firm power for Saturday at $25.00 (Northwest) and $26.00 (COB).
Sunday non-firm power from hours ending 0800 to 2200 was offered at $24.00 in the Northwest and at $25.00 at the California Oregon Border.
Sunday off peak non-firm power for the hours ended 0100 to 0700 and 2300 to 2400 was offered at $9.00 in the Northwest and the California Oregon Border.
Monday firm power during light load hours was offered at $9.00 in the Northwest and the California Oregon border.

Standard non-firm power for hours ending 0100 to 0500 and at 2400 on Monday was offered at $9.00 in the Northwest and the California Oregon Border, while non-firm power for hours ended 0600 and 2300 were offered at $10.00 in the Northwest and the California Oregon border.
